nodes.name: Operator inputs
nodes.notes: CHIP-ONLY CORRECTION: source_mode ownership_recompute requires manual revision with explicit market_date and new request_id; optional ownership_generation pins a verified 40hex data commit. NORMAL RUN: leave dates/request/run/preflight retry blank. Official calendar and 13:30 Taipei select latest completed session; Saturday resolves Friday. Existing exact request/run resumes; complete work reports without repeating it. diagnose is the explicit READ-ONLY Diagnostics branch; it does not screen, publish or archive. resume never dispatches missing runs. legacy_archive imports only retained immutable dates. revision requires a new request_id. Actions validates official source watermark before supplement. preflight_retry_execution_id is an explicit operator correction only after a confirmed local native validation failure and independent exact-run absence; it requires the released exact owner and searches existing runs before dispatch.
